tasks.subject: Task 1: color-bands.js pure model + tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A DOM-free module computing the palette, latitude-derived thresholds, band lookup, base band, and the color-change list, with full unit tests.

**Files:**
- Create: `js/color-bands.js`
- Test: `test/color-bands.test.mjs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `bandThresholds(lat)` returns ascending `[0, treeline, tundra, snowline]`, plateauing ≤30°, treeline→0 at ≥70°, snowline→0 at ≥75°, sign-symmetric.
- [ ] `bandOf(value, thresholds)` returns 0..4; exactly-at-threshold stays in the lower band.
- [ ] `baseBand(emin, thresholds)` folds thresholds ≤ emin into the base band (sea-level emin=0 → green, not blue).
- [ ] `colorChanges` maps Zt = base + (t−emin)·mmPerM·exag, drops thresholds at/below base or ≥ zmax, collapses coincident changes keeping the higher band.
- [ ] All tests pass; non-tautological.

**Verify:** `cd tilejs && node --test 'test/color-bands.test.mjs'` → all pass.

**Steps:** Write failing tests → implement js/color-bands.js (BAND_COLORS, TUNDRA_M, bandThresholds plateau-then-linear, bandOf strict>, baseBand t<=emin, colorChanges EPS=0.05 collapse-higher-band) → pass → commit. Full code in plan doc Task 1.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["js/color-bands.js", "test/color-bands.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd tilejs && node --test 'test/color-bands.test.mjs'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bandThresholds ascending/plateau/zeros/symmetric", "bandOf 0..4 strict-> boundaries", "baseBand folds t<=emin", "colorChanges Zt + range + collapse-higher-band"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: state, checkboxes & readout
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `colorBands`/`embedColorChanges` store fields, the two checkboxes, and the always-on readout of derived treeline/snowline, first-filament color, and change heights.

**Files:**
- Modify: `js/app.js` (store defaults ~line 19; event wiring ~line 305; imports; renderSettings ~line 365; new renderBandReadout)
- Modify: `index.html` (export controls, after #waterOpts ~line 78)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Store has `colorBands: false` and `embedColorChanges: false`.
- [ ] "Altitude color bands" toggles colorBands; nested "Embed color changes in 3MF (PrusaSlicer)" toggles embedColorChanges and is hidden while master off.
- [ ] When colorBands on and layout exists, readout shows center/treeline/snowline, first-loaded band name, and change list (or "no changes (single band)").
- [ ] When embedColorChanges on and layout has separate pieces (waterSeparate or a trail), a one-line warning shows.
- [ ] Existing tests pass; no behavior change when colorBands off.

**Verify:** `cd tilejs && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'` → all pass; manual: toggling checkbox shows/updates readout.

**Steps:** store defaults → HTML checkboxes + #bandOpts (#bandReadout,#bandWarn,hint) → change listeners → import color-bands.js → renderSettings sets checkbox/hidden + calls renderBandReadout (share f=layoutFit(s)) → renderBandReadout using baked.min/max frame + BAND_NAMES → suite → commit. Full code in plan doc Task 2.


tasks.subject: Task 3: preview top-surface banding
tasks.description:
**Goal:** When colorBands is on, color the preview top surface by altitude band (per-triangle by centroid Z) instead of the ramp; skirt/base stay neutral gray.

**Files:**
- Modify: `js/mesh.js` (buildPreviewSolid, lines 34–92)
- Modify: `js/app.js` (rebuildTiles, lines 538–561)
- Test: `test/color-bands-preview.test.mjs` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] buildPreviewSolid accepts geom.bandsZ (print-Z thresholds); when present each top triangle colored BAND_COLORS[bandOf(centroidZ, bandsZ)], all 3 vertices identical.
- [ ] When geom.bandsZ absent, coloring is byte-for-byte the current ramp/water/path behavior.
- [ ] rebuildTiles passes bandsZ when s.colorBands, computed base + (t - min)·mmPerM·exag.
- [ ] A test asserts a top triangle at a known centroid Z receives the expected band color.

**Verify:** `cd tilejs && node --test 'test/color-bands-preview.test.mjs'` → pass; full suite green.

**Steps:** failing test (2×2 flat grid elev 1500 → rock band 3) → mesh.js import bandOf,BAND_COLORS, destructure bandsZ, add zOf(id), color top tris by centroid band when bandsZ else ramp/water/path (skirt/base unchanged) → rebuildTiles compute+pass bandsZ → run → commit. Full code in plan doc Task 3.

tasks.subject: Task 4: embed PrusaSlicer color changes in 3MF
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Compute the export-frame change list and, when embedColorChanges is on, write it into the exported 3MF as a PrusaSlicer color-change part; geometry-only export stays byte-identical when off.

**Files:**
- Modify: `js/color-bands.js` (add prusaColorChangeXML)
- Modify: `js/threeMF.js` (optional color-change OPC part in finish())
- Modify: `js/app.js` (export3MF: emax/zmax, changes, pass to writer)
- Test: `test/color-bands.test.mjs` (extend: XML)
- Test: `test/threemf-colorchange.test.mjs` (new)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] prusaColorChangeXML(changes) returns well-formed <custom_gcodes_per_layer> with one <layer top_z type="2" extruder color gcode="M600"/> per change and <mode value="SingleExtruder"/>.
- [ ] ThreeMFWriter.setColorChanges(...); finish() adds Metadata/Prusa_Slicer_custom_gcode_per_print_z.xml + a [Content_Types].xml override when present; nothing when empty.
- [ ] Geometry-only 3MF (no changes) byte-identical to before.
- [ ] export3MF computes emax/zmax, builds changes when s.colorBands, passes to writer only when s.embedColorChanges.

**Verify:** `cd tilejs && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'` → pass. (PrusaSlicer load-test is Task 5.)

**Steps:** SPIKE reference (saved 2-change project → part name/root/attrs/type int; replace template if differs) → prusaColorChangeXML+hex+test → writer test (part present iff changes) → setColorChanges + CT override + extra entry in finish() → wire export3MF (emax,zmax,colorChanges,setColorChanges) → suite → commit. Full code in plan doc Task 4.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["js/color-bands.js", "js/threeMF.js", "js/app.js", "test/color-bands.test.mjs", "test/threemf-colorchange.test.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "cd tilejs && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["prusaColorChangeXML well-formed one-layer/change hex M600 SingleExtruder", "writer embeds part + CT override when set, nothing when empty", "geometry-only 3MF byte-identical when off", "export3MF emax/zmax + changes + writer under right flags"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: verify color changes load in PrusaSlicer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm that a real exported .3mf with embedding on loads its color changes in PrusaSlicer at the expected heights and colors; correct the container format (Task 4) if the reference differs.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in acceptanceCriteria has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify (only if the format is wrong): `js/color-bands.js` (prusaColorChangeXML), `js/threeMF.js` (part name / content type)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Export a layout with "Altitude color bands" + "Embed color changes" on; note the readout's change heights/colors.
- [ ] Open the exported .3mf as a project in PrusaSlicer; color-change markers appear on the vertical layer slider at Z ≈ the readout heights (within a layer height), each swatch matching the band color.
- [ ] Slicing shows the color bands at those heights in the preview (M600 inserted).
- [ ] If markers absent/misplaced, the real container format from the saved-project reference is applied to Task 4 and re-verified.

**Verify:** Manual — open tilejs_export.3mf as a project in PrusaSlicer; confirm color-change markers on the layer slider at the readout heights with matching swatches.

**Steps:** export mountainous layout with bands+embed; note readout → File→Open Project → compare slider markers Z/color (±layer) → slice, confirm bands → if wrong: save+unzip, diff part vs prusaColorChangeXML, fix Task 4, re-run tests, re-export, repeat → commit corrections.
